hero.title: About MENASCO
hero.description: For more than three decades, MENASCO has delivered integrated mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire-protection (MEP) engineering solutions that power some of the region's most demanding developments, from Dubai's skyline to mission-critical facilities across the UAE and GCC. Through technical expertise and disciplined project execution, we create reliable infrastructure that stands the test of time.

whoWeAre.heading: Who We Are
whoWeAre.paragraph1: MENASCO Mechanical Contracting LLC is one of the UAE's leading providers of integrated MEP engineering and contracting solutions, delivering high-performance building services across commercial, residential, industrial, hospitality, healthcare, infrastructure, and mission-critical developments.
whoWeAre.paragraph2: Founded in 1994, MENASCO has earned a reputation for engineering precision, technical excellence, and reliable project delivery. Today, our regional locations continue to grow through MENASCO Misr and MENASCO KSA, allowing us to support clients across the Middle East with consistent quality, innovation, and operational excellence.
whoWeAre.paragraph3: Our multidisciplinary teams combine engineering expertise, advanced technologies, and collaborative project management to deliver complete lifecycle MEP solutions, from design coordination and BIM integration through installation, commissioning, and project handover.
whoWeAre.quote: At MENASCO, we do more than install systems; we engineer environments that perform.

engineeringSupport.heading: Engineering and Support Leads
engineeringSupport.description: The specialists and department heads behind MENASCO's day-to-day project delivery.

Mr. Hani Badawiyeh: Mr. Hani Badawiyeh is a seasoned financial leader with over 22 years of experience in financial management, accounting, and strategic analysis. He holds a Bachelor's Degree in Financial Management and Accounting from the University of Jordan and has been a cornerstone in MENASCO's administrative and financial framework.

Throughout his distinguished career, Mr. Badawiyeh has demonstrated exceptional expertise in budget planning, financial reporting, and contract oversight, ensuring fiscal discipline and sustainable growth across all business operations.

His analytical precision and strategic approach have been instrumental in implementing effective financial governance, enhancing transparency, and optimizing performance efficiency, key pillars that uphold MENASCO's values of Integrity, Innovation, and Excellence.
Eng. Refad Al-Dwairi: Eng. Refad Al-Dwairi is a seasoned engineering and project management professional with over 20 years of experience delivering large-scale construction projects across regional and international markets. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering from the Jordan University of Science and Technology and an MBA from the University of Manchester, UK.

Recognized for blending technical precision with strategic leadership, Eng. Refad has successfully led numerous high-profile projects to completion, consistently achieving exceptional results in time, cost, and quality performance while ensuring full compliance with contractual, safety, and international standards.

As Chief Operating Officer of MENASCO, he plays a pivotal role in strengthening the company's operational capabilities and reinforcing its enduring commitment to Innovation, Integrity, and Excellence.
Eng. Ihab Saadi: Eng. Ihab Saadi is a seasoned construction and workforce management leader with over 25 years of experience in large-scale project execution, resource planning, and operational leadership. He oversees strategic workforce initiatives, ensuring seamless coordination across diverse teams.

Renowned for balancing strategic planning with on-the-ground execution, Eng. Saadi has successfully managed numerous high-profile and complex projects, demonstrating exceptional skill in resource optimization, budget control, and performance enhancement.
His leadership philosophy centers on empowerment, precision, and teamwork, driving innovation and fostering collaboration across all departments.
Eng. Mohamed Youssef: Eng. Mohamed Youssef brings over 15 years of extensive experience in contract management, commercial operations, and project administration across major construction and infrastructure developments. He holds a Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering from Alexandria University.

His credentials include membership of FIDIC (International Federation of Consulting Engineers), a Six Sigma certification in Leadership, Analysis & Project Management, and APC MRICS Certified Cost Specialist status.
With a rare blend of engineering expertise and commercial acumen, he has demonstrated exceptional capability in leading complex negotiations and maximizing project value.
Eng. Zakaria Motawe: Eng. Zakaria Motawe is a seasoned Electrical Engineer with extensive experience in designing, managing, and executing large-scale electromechanical projects across commercial, residential, and industrial developments.
He possesses deep technical expertise in electrical power distribution, ELV systems, and sustainable energy solutions, ensuring compliance with the highest engineering and safety standards.
As Engineering Lead – Electrical at MENASCO, he oversees electrical engineering operations, mentors project teams, and drives technical excellence from design through commissioning.
Mr. Ed Smith: With over two decades of international experience across the United States, India, and the Middle East, Ed Smith brings extensive leadership in quality assurance, infrastructure engineering, and project governance. Since joining MENASCO in 2017, he has led QA/QC operations across the UAE and KSA.
Ed is responsible for establishing and maintaining MENASCO's corporate Quality Management Systems (QMS), inspection protocols, and audit frameworks, ensuring full compliance with ISO 9001 standards.
A LEED Accredited Professional and Harvard Business School alumnus, Ed combines technical depth with strategic insight, fostering a culture of sustainability, accountability, and performance.
Eng. Rakan Abdullah: With over a decade of experience managing large-scale construction projects, Eng. Rakan combines strong technical engineering expertise with advanced leadership in digital project management, dedicated to advancing Building Information Modelling (BIM).

Starting his career as an Electrical Site Engineer, he built a solid foundation in design, installation, and execution before progressing into BIM Management, leading cross-functional teams and standardizing digital processes.
He holds RICS-accredited certifications and ISO 19650 qualifications, reinforcing his pursuit of global best practices in BIM management and integrated engineering solutions.

profileCta.heading: Meet the People Behind MENASCO
profileCta.description: Discover the leadership, expertise, and shared values driving MENASCO's continued growth and engineering excellence.

messageParagraphs: Bahaa Badawiyeh is the Chief Executive Officer of MENASCO Group, leading the organization with a philosophy that combines engineering expertise, strategic vision, operational discipline & a deep understanding of people.

Throughout his journey with MENASCO, he has played a central role in transforming the company from a growing MEP contractor into MENASCO Group, an integrated engineering organization with expanding operations across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, & the United Kingdom.

Under his leadership, MENASCO Group has strengthened its capabilities in integrated MEP solutions, digital engineering, prefabrication, infrastructure & complex mission-critical projects. He has driven innovation-led growth, enhanced operational performance & reinforced the Group's ability to deliver reliable, precise & high-value engineering solutions.

His leadership approach is founded on the belief that engineering excellence begins with people. He promotes collaboration, accountability, knowledge-sharing & continuous development across multidisciplinary teams, empowering the Group's engineers, specialists & project leaders to perform with a shared sense of purpose.

Bahaa places strong emphasis on sustainability, ethical business practices, transparency & social responsibility. He continues to support initiatives that improve environmental performance, promote an inclusive workplace & create lasting value for clients, communities, employees & partners.
Under his direction, MENASCO Group continues to expand its regional & international capabilities while remaining firmly guided by its core values of Innovation, Integrity, Excellence.

For Bahaa, leadership is not defined by individual achievement but by the ability to unite people behind a shared vision: to build with integrity, innovate with purpose & create a legacy of engineering excellence that endures for generations.
bahaa-badawiyeh.closingLine: To build with integrity, innovate with purpose, and create a legacy of excellence that endures for generations.

messageParagraphs: Since founding MENASCO Mechanical Contracting L.L.C. in 1994, our ambition has remained clear: to build a trusted engineering company founded on technical excellence, integrity & unwavering commitment to our clients.

Drawing on more than five decades of experience in engineering & construction I have witnessed the industry evolve through periods of rapid growth, technological advancement & increasing project complexity. Throughout this journey MENASCO, has continued to adapt strengthen its capabilities & uphold the principles on which it was established.

Over more than three decades, MENASCO has grown into a respected name in the electromechanical contracting sector, delivering integrated MEP solutions across the UAE and key regional markets. Our expertise spans HVAC, electrical, plumbing & drainage, fire protection, BIM & digital engineering, prefabrication & specialized solutions for complex & mission-critical projects.

Our achievements have been made possible by the dedication of our people, the confidence of our clients & the enduring relationships we have built with consultants, developers, contractors, suppliers & strategic partners. Together, they have played an essential role in every milestone we have reached.

As we look to the future, we remain committed to sustainable growth, continuous improvement & the adoption of innovative engineering solutions that create lasting value, guided by our values of Innovation, Integrity, Excellence, we will continue to strengthen our capabilities, exceed our clients' expectations & contribute to building resilient communities & cities for future generations.
We look forward to creating new success stories, building enduring partnerships & continuing to transform innovation into reality.

seo.title: ESG & Sustainability
seo.description: MENASCO's ESG strategy reflects its commitment to sustainable construction, environmental responsibility and ethical governance as a leading UAE MEP contractor.

hero.heading: Environmental, Social & Governance (ESG)
hero.description: MENASCO is committed to Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles that guide how we design, build, and operate as a leading Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) contractor in the UAE. Our ESG philosophy centers on delivering sustainable engineering solutions that create long-term value for our clients, employees, communities, and the environment.

pillars.heading: Environmental
paragraphs: Sustainability is embedded into every stage of our project delivery, from planning and procurement through construction and facility handover. We prioritize energy-efficient engineering solutions, responsible material selection, and the efficient use of resources, while working continuously to reduce waste and environmental impact across our operations.

pillars.heading: Social
paragraphs: Our people are at the center of everything we do. MENASCO is committed to employee wellbeing, health and safety, and workforce development, supported by ongoing training and professional development. We foster a respectful, inclusive workplace culture that values diversity, and we extend that same commitment beyond our teams, engaging with the communities where we operate while building ethical, long-term partnerships with clients and suppliers alike.

pillars.heading: Governance
paragraphs: Responsible governance underpins how MENASCO conducts business. We hold ourselves to high standards of ethical conduct, transparency, and accountability, supported by robust compliance and risk management practices. This disciplined approach to corporate responsibility protects the long-term interests of our clients, employees, and partners, and helps ensure integrity is maintained across every project we deliver.

pillars.heading: Continuous Improvement
paragraphs: ESG is not a separate initiative at MENASCO; it is integrated into our long-term strategy. By embedding environmental, social, and governance principles into how we plan, build, and operate, we drive innovation, operational excellence, and sustainable growth, ensuring responsible project delivery across the UAE and the wider region.

seo.title: Innovation & Technology
seo.description: MENASCO advances construction technology through LYNXqc field quality management, an enterprise data platform, and intelligent automation across every project.

hero.heading: Innovation & Technology
hero.subheading: Engineering the Future Through Intelligent Technology
hero.description: MENASCO is investing in proprietary technologies, artificial intelligence, enterprise data systems, automation, and digital engineering platforms to improve project delivery, operational efficiency, compliance, quality, and decision-making across the organization.

atlas.heading: Automatic Tendering Logic Assessment System (ATLAS)
atlas.paragraph: ATLAS is MENASCO's AI-powered compliance platform, evaluating engineering designs against applicable codes, standards, and regulatory frameworks to improve readiness for review before submission across technically demanding project types, from mission-critical facilities to hospitality and residential developments.

lynxqc.heading: LYNXqc
lynxqc.paragraph: LYNXqc is MENASCO's intelligent field quality management platform, built to make identifying, assigning, and resolving construction issues faster and more transparent. Using photos, voice notes, and AI-assisted issue recognition, LYNXqc captures critical site information and routes it to the right teams for action. From initial observation through verification and closure, every issue is tracked in one auditable workflow, improving accountability, visibility, and quality across projects.

ai.heading: Artificial Intelligence & Intelligent Automation
ai.paragraph: MENASCO is integrating artificial intelligence across its operations, from predictive analytics to workflow automation, to support engineers and project teams with faster, more informed decisions, not replace them.

dataLake.heading: Enterprise Data Lake
dataLake.paragraph: MENASCO is building a centralized data platform that consolidates information from every major operational system across the business, turning operational data into real-time visibility and better-informed decisions.

connect.heading: MENASCO Connect
connect.paragraph: MENASCO Connect is our proprietary collaboration platform, unifying engineering, commercial, planning, QA/QC, and every other department into one digital workflow, accelerating administrative decisions to ensure consistent delivery across every project.

closing.heading: Engineering Tomorrow
closing.description: MENASCO believes the future of engineering lies in combining decades of construction expertise with intelligent technologies that improve quality, efficiency, sustainability, compliance, and project certainty. Technology is not replacing engineering: it is empowering our engineers to deliver better outcomes for clients and projects.

qualitySafetyPage.heading: Quality, Health & Safety
qualitySafetyPage.description: MENASCO delivers electro-mechanical and MEP contracting services across the UAE, built on quality management, health and safety, and engineering excellence, governed by an integrated QHSE system certified to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018.
qualitySafetyPage.paragraph1: As a mechanical contracting and MEP engineering company operating across the UAE, MENASCO continually works to ensure our electro-mechanical services and the quality of our work meet the highest standards in the construction industry. Every process we run is governed by an integrated management system certified to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018, internationally recognized standards for Quality, Health, Safety, and Environmental (QHSE) management.
